ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the line $y=kx+3$ passes through the point $(2,0)$. What is the solution set of the inequality $kx+3>0$ with respect to $x$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since the line $y=kx+3$ passes through the point $(2,0)$,\\
it follows that the solution set of the inequality $kx+3>0$ with respect to $x$ is $\boxed{x<2}$.
